note: Salted SHA-256 of terms that must never reach a published surface. The salt lives in identity_salt.local.txt, which is gitignored and never leaves the desk machine; without it these digests are not invertible by wordlist. This file therefore discloses nothing in fact, not only in claim. Losing the salt means re-adding every term - the plaintext is retained nowhere. Add with `python identity_guard.py add`.
legacy_note: Unsalted digests from schema 1.0 whose plaintext was not recovered at migration. Still matched against unsalted token hashes so coverage is not lost; re-add the term to retire the entry.
